page.overview:
What is Canalave City?

In the bottom left corner is a house with a sign outside. Inside is Sailor Eldritch and his wife and son. After obtaining the National Pokédex, the Sailor's son gets struck with nightmares of which he cannot awake. He thrashes around in his sleep and says "Dar... Dark... Is watching me...". To awaken the Sailor's son, the player character must go to Fullmoon Island and retrieve the Lunar Wing from Cresselia which will cure the Sailor's son of nightmares.

A locked house in the top right corner is a house (The Harbor Inn) that requires the Member Card to open. Before opening, the player character must obtain the Lunar Wing and help the Sailor's son out of his nightmares. Not long after opening the Inn, an old man will talk to the player character, asking if you would like to sleep. Accepting this will make you have a nightmare of which the player character go to Newmoon Island, to battle/catch Darkrai. After catching/defeating Darkrai, the player character will wake up from your nightmare. Sleeping in the same bed will take you back to Newmoon Island where you can battle Darkrai again if the player character fled/fainted in battle.
